newsitem.title: QATAR: Syrian vice-president in Qatar for talks.
newsitem.headline: Syrian vice-president in Qatar for talks.

text.p: Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam arrived in Doha on Thursday on a regional tour to win support for Syria's stand in the Middle East peace process.
Qatar's official news agency said he was accompanied by Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara. They flew in from Bahrain.

The two senior Syrian officials are trying to drum up support for Syria's peace stand after Israel and the PLO ended their deadlock on a partial Israeli withdrawal from the West Bank town of Hebron earlier this month, Gulf Arab newspapers have said.
Their Gulf Arab swing has included Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman and the United Arab Emirates.
